source_description: Implements GitHub issue #518 (sub-issue of Epic #507) per ADR-0003. Build the foundation of the Felix↔Vikunja sync architecture: a centralized deterministic reconciliation driver covering status and task layers, a 15-field conflict-event log, and a direct deterministic WhatsApp send path for unsafe-class conflicts. Discovery decision (2026-06-04): WhatsApp delivery is direct from the driver (Directive 6 alignment); build a reusable send helper if no existing deterministic send path is exposed. Out of scope: touchpoint migration (#519), project-layer + deletion + URL normalization (#520).
